_comment: The rename map for merging sgs/account's duplicate empty orders button settings into the built-in button kit's. `ordersEmptyButtonPadding` and `ordersEmptyButtonMinHeight` painted the same element and property as `emptyStatePadding` and `emptyStateMinHeight` (`.sgs-account__orders-empty-actions .sgs-button`; the kit's rule weighs more, so the kit's value won where both were set). Saved content still carries the old names, which the block no longer reads: scripts/sweep-builtin-button-attrs.php map=account-empty-button-renames.json folds each into the kit's setting per device and per side (the kit's own values win), then drops the old key. No deprecated.js (FP-14).

renames.evidence: block_attributes: sgs/account padding, css_element ordersEmptyButton; helpers-account-signed-out.php prints the emptyState kit on the same selector
block_attributes: sgs/account min-height, css_element ordersEmptyButton; helpers-account-signed-out.php prints the emptyState kit on the same selector
